description: Source code for a React component implementing a modal dialog for selecting channels, with search, pagination, and multi-select features in a Mattermost web application.

classes.name: ChannelSelectorModal
classes.description: React component class for a modal dialog to select channels with search and pagination.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads initial channels when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles search term changes to update channel list.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal and resets search term.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Callback for modal exit, triggers optional dismiss callback.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, calls selection callback.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a channel to the selected values.

methods.name: handlePageChange
methods.description: Loads additional channels when page changes.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Handles search input and updates search term.

methods.name: renderOption
methods.description: Renders individual channel options in the list.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal with multi-select component.
